nodes.title: FET Phase
nodes.description: Further Education and Training Phase (Grades 10-12)

nodes.title: Information Technology
nodes.description: Information Technology — Grade 12 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Information Technology Grade 12 Term 1 covering Database Design and Concepts, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Hardware, Database Management, SQL, Social Implications and PAT.

nodes.title: Database Design and Concepts
nodes.description: Relational database design, normalisation, transaction processing, characteristics of a good database design, caring for and managing data, hacking through data, data collection, location-based data, data warehousing and mining, problems with databases, split tables and relations.

assessmentStandards: Explain and motivate relational database design
Characteristics of a good database design
Example of basic relationship enabled by the utilisation of key fields

nodes.title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
nodes.description: Reinforce past programming skills, parameterised and non-parameterised constructors, private and public attributes, accessor, mutator and auxiliary methods, ToString method, instantiation of objects, correct use of methods of various objects as part of problem solving.

assessmentStandards: Correct use of private and public attributes, accessor, mutator and auxiliary methods
The use of the ToString method and accessor methods to provide output
Correct use of methods of various objects as part of problem solving

nodes.title: Hardware
nodes.description: Mobile technologies, factors influencing performance of a computer, motivate a typical computer system in respect of user requirements.

assessmentStandards: Overview of factors influencing performance of a computer
Motivate a typical computer system in respect of user requirements

nodes.title: SQL
nodes.description: Design and develop a solution incorporating SQL, SELECT all or some fields (FROM).

assessmentStandards: Design and develop a solution incorporating SQL

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Advantages and disadvantages of how mobile technology impacts on privacy (personal and business), IoT technologies enabling the IoT and their impact on society.

assessmentStandards: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages how mobile technology impacts on privacy (personal and business)
IoT - technologies enabling the IoT and their impact on society

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Information Technology Grade 12 Term 2 covering Systems Technologies, SQL (advanced queries, joins, aggregate functions), Solution Development (2D arrays), Social Implications and Mid-Year Examination.

nodes.title: Systems Technologies
nodes.description: Factors influencing computer management, cloud computing, virtual reality, augmented reality, virtualisation.

nodes.title: SQL - Advanced
nodes.description: DISTINCT and ORDER BY, calculated fields (AS), ROUND, INT, LENGTH, LEFT, RIGHT, MID, concatenating fields, WHERE clause with operators, wildcards, date queries, INSERT, DELETE, UPDATE, aggregate functions, create join queries.

assessmentStandards: WHERE with >, >=, <, <=, =, LIKE, BETWEEN, AND, OR, NOT, IS NULL, NULL, IN
Insert, delete, update ONE and then multiple records
Create a join query (single joins) using 'Where'
Queries with parameters where the user input is given

nodes.title: Solution Development - 2D Arrays
nodes.description: Arrays as a data structure (2-dimensional).

nodes.title: Solution Development - Problem Solving
nodes.description: Consolidate and reinforce content, concepts and skills, design and develop solutions for a variety of problems including computational thinking and applying software engineering principles.

assessmentStandards: Consolidate and reinforce content, concepts and skills
Design and develop solutions for a variety of problems that include computational thinking and applying software engineering principles

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Computer criminals and computer crime.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Information Technology Grade 12 Term 3 covering Software Engineering, Internet Services Technologies, Communication Technologies, Social Implications, Solution Development consolidation and Trial Examination.

nodes.title: Software Engineering
nodes.description: Reinforce software engineering principles.

nodes.title: Internet Services Technologies
nodes.description: Improve searching, online applications, role of SQL and scripting languages, formatting output.

nodes.title: Communication Technologies
nodes.description: Essential parts to link nodes, connecting to the Internet, sharing concepts, online services, remote access, overview of security concepts.

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Explain how computers provide solutions to issues.

assessmentStandards: Explain how computers provide solutions to issues

nodes.title: Solution Development - Consolidation
nodes.description: Consolidate and reinforce content, concepts and skills, design and develop solutions for a variety of problems including computational thinking and applying software engineering principles.

assessmentStandards: Consolidate and reinforce content, concepts, and skills
Design and develop solutions for a variety of problems that include computational thinking and applying software engineering principles

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Information Technology Grade 12 Term 4 covering content consolidation using case studies across all topics and Final NSC Examination.

nodes.title: Consolidation Using Case Studies
nodes.description: Content using case studies across all topics to prepare for the Final NSC Examination.

assessmentStandards: Content using case studies - all topics
